title: Filling and Emptying Cystometries ("Backwards Cystometry"): a Feasibility and Validation Study
brief_summary: This study evaluate the feasibility and the accuracy of an emptying cystometry in order to simplify the manometric follow-up of overactive detrusor in neurological patients under anticholinergic or botulinum toxin injections.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Follow in neuro-urology for lower urinary tract symptoms
* Appointment for urodynamic assessment

Exclusion Criteria:

* detrusor overactivity
* micturition during or at the end of the filling cystometry
study_population: Patients consulting for an urodynamic assessment in a tertiary center in neuro-urology
